findings.issue: In `validateManipulationActionSlices`, the overlap check `other.startMs<action.endMs&&other.endMs>action.startMs` allows half-open intervals to overlap concurrently, but for idle actions with unspecified hand (`!other.hand&&other.type==='idle'`), it checks `rigHand(other)===rigHand(action)`. However, `rigHand(other)` throws on undefined hand, or conversely, if evaluated, it conflicts; furthermore, an idle action with unspecified hand spans both hands and should conflict with any active contact hand during the slice interval. More crucially, line 47 tests `rigHand(other)===rigHand(action)` only when `!other.hand&&other.type==='idle'` is false, but if `other.hand` is undefined and `other.type!=='idle'`, `rigHand(other)` throws.
findings.proposedSourceChange:
if(actions.some(other=>other!==raw&&!other.sourceManipulation&&((!other.hand&&other.type==='idle')||(other.hand&&rigHand(other)===rigHand(action)))&&other.startMs<action.endMs&&other.endMs>action.startMs))
      throw new Error('needs-source-action: another shot-local action owns the original contact hand');

decisions.reason: rigHand is a total accessor, packages/core/identifiers.ts:6 value.hand??right, not a throwing function. Unbound idle short-circuits and occupies both hands; non-idle without hand preserves legacy default right. Proposed guard other.hand would silently permit an actual default-right conflict.
